newsitem.title: UK: Druid Group sees shares floating at 230-290p in UK.
newsitem.headline: Druid Group sees shares floating at 230-290p in UK.

text.p: British management consultancy firm Druid Group Plc said on Tuesday it expected its ordinary shares to price at 230p to 290p in their flotation on the London Stock Exchange. Based on an indicative placing price of 260p, Druid said the flotation would give it a market capitalisation of about 59.7 million stg.
The company planned to raise up to six million stg before expenses in the flotation.
Up to roughly 14.4 million ordinary shares are being made available in the offer, with up to 11.6 sold by existing shareholders and up to 2.8 million offered by the company for subscription.
Up to 350,000 new ordinary shares are being made available for subscription to employees, Druid said in a statement.
The company forecast that its turnover and pretax profit would be not less than 9.15 million stg and 1.75 million stg, respectively, for the six months ending December 31.
In the year-earlier period, the company posted turnover of 4.56 million stg and a pretax profit of 860,000 stg.
Druid expected to pay a net interim dividend of 0.8p per ordinary share in April 1997.
Druid said the placing price and size of its offer would be announced on, or as soon as possible, after November 12.
Dealing in the shares was expected to begin on November 19.
SBC Warbrug will act as underwriter for the deal.
Druid, which employs 240 staff, has a consultancy team specialising in SAP AG software implementation.
